Opposite party no.2 has tendered his appearance by way of filing Vakalatnama, however, on repeated calls, nobody appears on behalf of opposite party no.2 and in view of that, this petition is being heard in absence of opposite party no.2.
2.
Heard Mr. Vishal Kumar Tiwary, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. Shashi Kumar Verma, learned counsel for the State.

3. The prayer is made for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order taking cognizance dated 04.10.2017 in C Case No.101/2017, pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla.

entities.text: Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Earlier an FIR was lodged by opposite party no.2 against one Indradeo Tiwari, which was numbered as Gumla P.S. Case No.114/2015, corresponding to G.R. No.375/2015, registered under Sections 135, 136, 137 and 138 of the Indian Electricity Act alleging therein that on 16.03.2015,
opposite party no.2 has inspected the shop of the petitioner and found the evidence of theft of electricity and, thereafter, an FIR was lodged in the name of the consumer.

The said FIR was Gajadhar Nath Tiwari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101693523/
1 investigated by the police and it was found that the FIR was lodged against the dead person and the final form was submitted indicating therein that the informant is free to lodge a separate FIR against the proper person and, thereafter, the present protest complaint case was filed against petitioner nos. 1 and 2, who are son and grand son of Late Indradeo Tiwari.

entities.text: Gajadhar Nath Tiwari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Mr. Tiwary, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the said FIR was investigated by the police and final form was submitted disclosing therein that Indradeo Tiwari, against whom, FIR was registered, has already left for his heavenly abode three years prior to lodging of the said FIR and in the final form, it has also been stated that the informant may take step in accordance with law.
He further submits that on the protest petition, the learned Court has been pleased to take cognizance against the petitioners under Sections 403, 419, 420 and 379 of the Indian Penal Code.

He submits that the present protest case was filed under Sections 135, 136, 137 and 138 of the Indian Electricity Act, 2003, however, the learned Court has been pleased to take cognizance under the sections of the Indian Penal Code.

He further submits that in the protest petition, there is disclosure of SC/ST Case P.S. Case No.1/2015, which has already been quashed by this Court in Cr.M.P. No.1846 of 2015, vide order dated 14.09.2023.

By way of referring paragraph 4 of the protest petition, he submits that the statement is already there that Indradeo Tiwari has already left for his heavenly abode, however, it was alleged that petitioner nos.1 and 2, who happen to be son and grandson of Late Indradeo Tiwari,
they have committed theft of electricity.
He submits that maliciously the present case has been filed against the petitioners.

6. Mr. Verma, learned counsel for the State submits that it appears that the learned Court has taken cognizance under sections of the Indian Penal code on the protest petition filed under Sections 135,
136, 137 and 138 of the Indian Electricity Act, 2003.

7. It is an admitted position that the said FIR was investigated by the police and final form was submitted disclosing therein that Indradeo Tiwary has already left for his heavenly abode three years prior to lodging of the said FIR.

It was further disclosed in the final form that the authority may take further steps in accordance with law and, thereafter, the present protest case was filed under Sections 135, 136, 137 and 138 of the Indian Electricity Act, 2003, however, the learned Court has been pleased to take cognizance under Sections 403, 419, 420 and 379 of the Indian Penal Code.

8. Further, in paragraph 3 of the present protest case, there is disclosure of one of the case being SC/ST P.S. Case No.1/2015 and that has already been quashed by this Court in Cr.M.P. No.1846 of 2015, vide order dated 14.09.2023.
9.

In paragraph 4 of the present protest case, it was stated that Indradeo Tiwari has already left for his heavenly abode and in spite of that, the petitioners have been implicated by way of filing present protest case saying that they were sitting in the shop and in view of that, they have theft the electricity.

These facts clearly suggest that the present protest case was maliciously filed against the petitioners and lodging of the earlier FIR against the dead person further strengthens malicious prosecution.
